scenes.text: You’re packing your bags for the ultimate Arctic adventure, but there’s one bizarre law you absolutely must know before you land in the remote town of Longyearbyen, Norway, where it is actually illegal to die.
If you ever get terminally ill or are about to pass away, the local government will literally fly you off the frozen island immediately to the mainland.

Because of the extreme arctic temperatures, the ground is permanent permafrost, meaning buried bodies never decompose—which was proven when scientists found active 1918 Spanish flu viruses still preserved inside them.
To avoid a massive biological health disaster, death was banned completely, so tell me in the comments if you would ever dare to live here, and follow for more insane facts!
